items.title: Refining a hypercovering along a covering of one level
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Given a covering u : Z -> K_k in SR(C,X), build a morphism of hypercoverings f : L -> K with L_k -> K_k factoring through u: use the cosimplicial set C[k] and the Simplicial identifications of Hom(C[k], -); form L = K x_{Hom(C[k],Y)} Hom(C[k],Z) with Y = K_k and the canonical K -> Hom(C[k],Y) from id_Y; the factorization at level k follows from the pullback square whose bottom composite is the identity; then verify L is a hypercovering via lemma-funny-gamma: condition (1) by assumption, condition (2) because Hom(C[k],Z)_0 -> Hom(C[k],Y)_0 is isomorphic to Z -> Y (only one map [k]->[0]), condition (3) by proving the claim that Hom(C[k],T)_{n+1} -> (cosk_n sk_n Hom(C[k],T))_{n+1} is functorially a projection prod_S T -> prod_{S'} T, computing S' as the quotient of {0,...,n+1} x Map([k],[n]) by the face relations (f_{i,delta o beta} = f_{j,delta o beta}), so the gamma-arrow is a product of coverings and hence a covering by lemma-covering-permanence.
